I could not finish this. I have no code-execution tool here, so I could not diagonalize the doublet blocks, and I did not save a plot.

**What I computed (quartet levels, in units of B, relative to the ground state):**
- ⁴A₂g: 0 at all Dq/B.
- ⁴T₂g: 10·Dq/B.
- ⁴T₁g (F/P pair): 7.5 + 15d ± √(56.25 − 45d + 25d²), where d = Dq/B. At d = 0 this gives 0 (⁴T₁g(F)) and 15 (⁴T₁g(P)).

I derived the ⁴T₁ block from the trace of V² over the quartet space, which gives an F–P off-diagonal Dq element of 4Dq. I have not checked this against a published matrix.

**What is missing:** the ²Eg, ²T₁g and ²T₂g levels from the doublet terms (²P, ²D×2, ²F, ²G, ²H), which depend on C = 4.094·B. These are needed to fill the six lowest levels at every grid point, so the list below is incomplete and should not be used as the diagram.

| Dq/B | ⁴A₂g | ⁴T₂g | ⁴T₁g(F) lower | ⁴T₁g upper | doublets |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0.0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 15 | not computed |
| 0.5 | 0 | 5 | 8.68 | 21.33 | not computed |
| 1.0 | 0 | 10 | 16.48 | 28.52 | not computed |
| 1.5 | 0 | 15 | 23.29 | 36.71 | not computed |
| 2.0 | 0 | 20 | 29.36 | 45.64 | not computed |
| 2.5 | 0 | 25 | 35.00 | 55.00 | not computed |
| 3.0 | 0 | 30 | 40.41 | 64.59 | not computed |
| 3.5 | 0 | 35 | 45.68 | 74.32 | not computed |
| 4.0 | 0 | 40 | 50.88 | 84.12 | not computed |

The "lower" and "upper" columns are the two ⁴T₁g roots, which are the F- and P-derived levels in the order they fall at each Dq/B. Their labels are not assigned here.

The structured output below therefore carries only these quartet levels, with image_path and image_sha256 null because no image was saved.
